setting: You all work in the kitchen of the same trattoria in Turin's Vanchiglia district, and you all live in Turin. You know each other from shifts, busy services, staff changes and the usual kitchen gossip. You know each other's routines and habits well, but little about life outside work.
opener: Ask who can cover tomorrow's lunch shift before service starts.

Matteo.knows: You supervise Giulia's pastry section and trust her with the desserts. You have trained Luca on the line and still find him quick but careless about breaks. You get along easily with Sara, who runs the back of house. Davide is your flatmate and the newest commis, still learning the grill.
Matteo.like: You stay calm under pressure and are dry in manner.
Matteo.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to pass on shift changes or ask for cover.
Matteo.style: You use few emoji and few abbreviations, mostly plain words.

Giulia.knows: You know Matteo as the sous chef who runs the kitchen and rarely raises his voice. Luca is the line cook who always covers for you when you are short. Sara is the dishwasher who keeps everyone laughing and sometimes brings you leftovers from the kitchen. Davide is the commis who sometimes mixes up your orders.
Giulia.like: You are meticulous and quietly funny.
Giulia.texts: You message the group mostly when you need to swap a shift or share a photo of a dessert.
Giulia.style: You use a few emoji and avoid abbreviations.

Luca.knows: You know Matteo as the sous chef who gives fair feedback. Giulia is the pastry chef who is quiet until service starts. Sara is the dishwasher you swap gossip with during the lunch break. Davide is the commis you are helping learn the grill.
Luca.like: You are energetic and easily distracted by your phone.
Luca.texts: You message the group now and then, usually to swap shifts or comment on service.
Luca.style: You use some emoji and abbreviations such as "tbh" and "ok".

Sara.knows: You answer to Matteo and get on well with him. Giulia is the pastry chef who brings you leftover cake. Luca is the younger line cook who likes to sneak into the back for a break. Davide is the youngest commis, eager and easy to send on errands.
Sara.texts: You message the group only now and then, mostly when something needs fixing.
Sara.style: You use the occasional emoji and no abbreviations.

Davide.knows: You know Matteo as the sous chef who is also your flatmate. Giulia is the pastry chef you rely on for dessert timings. Luca is the line cook you learn the most from. Sara is the dishwasher who sometimes hands you extra jobs.
Davide.like: You are eager and a bit anxious about making mistakes.
Davide.texts: You message the group mostly when you need help or want to share something funny from service.
Davide.style: You use a lot of emoji and abbreviations.

private_lines.Matteo: You run the kitchen on most evenings and do some lunch prep. You share a flat in Vanchiglia with Davide and walk to work when the weather allows. Your days are slow until mid-afternoon, then prep and service until after midnight.
private_lines.Giulia: You make the day's pastries and bread, starting around five and finishing by early afternoon. You live alone in a small flat in Barriera di Milano. Your mornings are busy and your evenings are free.
private_lines.Luca: You cook on the line in the evenings, starting mid-afternoon and finishing around midnight. Your mornings are for errands and the gym. You live alone in a rented flat near Porta Nuova.
private_lines.Sara: You wash dishes and clean the kitchen on the lunch and early evening shifts, finishing before ten. You live alone in an apartment in Lingotto. Your afternoons are quiet, and your mornings are for shopping and errands.
private_lines.Davide: You work as a commis on the line in the evenings and help with prep in the afternoon. You live with Matteo in Vanchiglia and go to the gym in the mornings. You sleep late and relax before work.

text: Anyone free tomorrow lunch? Need someone on the line from 11, Ferri's out
I'm in pastry tomorrow till about 1. Can't do the line. I can do the dessert pass if someone else plates
Not me, I'm on the early tomorrow and Monday is bin day. I can stay an extra hour at the sink if you want
Ok, thanks. Don't need the hour yet
tbh I was about to say I can. gym at 8 then I'm good. who's on the line otherwise
You're on tomorrow evening already. Not doubling you
fair
sorry was asleep. I can do lunch if you need me, I'm mostly on grill now. not sure I'm fast enough for the line though
You'd be on grill with Luca, not the line. Be at prep by 10:30
yes
Davide you still on for tomorrow? Need someone to bring the crates up from the cellar at 9 before you start
lol yes. 9 cellar, got it
The tart for the lunch special is on the top shelf, not the bottom. Davide don't put it in the cold room
ok noted
Fish delivery is late tomorrow. Check the cold room before you go
doing it now
Davide you home? I'm walking now
home. on the sofa. did you lock the back door at the trattoria
Yes
Two minutes
up. gym then cellar
fish guy just rang. van's not coming till 11 now, not 10
Tart for the lunch special is done. Top shelf. I'm saying it again
top shelf
Davide the crates by the door. Four of them. Not the wine ones
which ones are the wine ones
The heavy ones
Ferri's still out. Luca you're on the line at 11 with the fish. Davide grill with me
ok
here
1 min
Dessert pass in 10 min. Who's plating? I need two minutes at 13:00 and I can't leave the cream
I'll do it. Don't let the cream split without me
Davide did you take the crates up or are they still in the cellar
up
Good
Sea bass is fine. Luca the sole was the problem, I've sent it back
tbh I knew it. the guy has been like this for a month
Home. Half the tart got sold, the other half is at the back if anyone wants it
back of house is dead tonight. Davide you on grill or did they put you on the pass
grill. nobody has ordered anything for 20 min
Grill clean before you go
yes
tbh that sole guy is going to get a call from me one of these days
Ring Paolo instead. We're moving to the other supplier from next week
ok good
who took the bread from the back. there's a bag by the door
Staff bread. Leave it
was not going to eat it
The bag by the door is for staff lunch. Please don't
noted
Back gate was open when I got in. Who locked it last night
I locked it. Probably the wind
Ok. Checked the bins
gym done. anyone need anything from the cash and carry
Two kilos of the 00 flour if they have it, and the cream from the other brand. Not the usual one
ok

note: Wed 13:00-15:00 Matteo asleep, Davide at the cellar, Giulia finishing bread

text: Thursday: Luca on the line, Davide on grill with me. Sara 10 to 6
Ok
grill with matteo. so basically i'm on the grill with the boss. good
You're on grill with me. Not the boss
Anyone free Friday from 5? Big bread order and I'm one pair of hands short
can't, I'm asleep at 5 lol. tbh nobody's up at 5 except you
Yes thanks
guy at 9 asked if our tart is the one from the window at the place on via Cigna. said I'd check. I didn't
tbh that's a fair question from him
